questions.title: Resistance wire in a series–parallel circuit
questions.summary: A length L of wire in parallel with one resistor X, in series with a second X across which V is measured. (E − V)/L = PV − Q with P = 2k/R and Q = kE/R. Sketch how a smaller R changes the line, then integrate an AC current dataset.

xlsx.desc: Seven (L, V) readings. Compute (E − V)/L and plot it against V.
A practice version of datasetQ1g: sinusoidal current every 0.25 ms. Integrate the first half-cycle for Q₁.

questions.title: Oscillating wooden strip (compound pendulum)
questions.summary: Find the balance point, hang the strip from holes at distance y = a − z from its centre of mass, and plot T²y against y²: gradient M = 4π²/g, intercept Mb². Plan how a magnet, coil and voltage sensor could time the swing.

xlsx.desc: z and 20-oscillation timings for seven holes. Compute y, T²y and y²; find M, b and g.

questions.title: Stability of a container of water
questions.summary: Tilt a capped container until it topples and read the angle on a quadrant scale. Adding water first lowers then raises the centre of mass, so the toppling angle θ peaks. Test cos²θ = kh/((d/2)² + h²) and plan how to choose the minimum stable diameter.

xlsx.desc: θ against h from 0 to 6 cm; find the h for maximum θ and test the suggested relationship.
